report:
**Screen methodology-390 (390px)**
- **Header responsive state:** The preview renders a desktop-style header at 390 px (exposed text links “rankings / about / news / membership”, “vendors” pill, and “sign up” button). The design shows a collapsed mobile header containing only the PEPTTRACE logo and a hamburger menu icon.
- **Standards table column header:** The preview table omits or obscures the “SOMETIMES” header; the design clearly displays all five column headers (STANDARD, PURITY, QUANTITY, LABELING, SOMETIMES).
- **Horizontal page padding:** Preview body copy sits closer to the viewport edges than in the design, which maintains more generous side margins.
- **Footer link route (non-visual but impacts active state):** Footer “Testing Methodology” likely still points to `/testing-methodology`; design canonical route is `/methodology`.

**Screen methodology-744 (744px)**
- **Labeling Score Calculated — right column list items:** The preview renders “Batch identifier” and “Batch claim communication” as cards with full rectangular borders. The design shows them as list rows with only a left accent border and no surrounding box border.
- **Standards table:** Preview lacks the distinct vertical borders between columns that are visible in the design.

**Screen methodology-1440 (1440px)**
- **Methodology two-column proportions:** The preview Analysts column is too narrow (roughly 35–40 %), causing excessive line-wrapping compared to the design’s wider Analysts column (roughly 45–50 %). The Vendors column is disproportionately wide.
- **Standards table vertical rules:** The design shows clear vertical borders separating the five columns; the preview table has only horizontal separators (or very faint vertical ones).
- **Labeling Score Calculated — right column items:** Same as 744 px: preview uses full card borders instead of the design’s left-border-only list aesthetic.
- **Labeling Score Works cards:** Preview cards have visible rectangular borders and white backgrounds. The design uses flat grey-filled cards with no visible border.
- **Vertical section spacing:** Gaps between major sections (e.g., between Standards and Labeling, or Formulas and Reading Results) are tighter in the preview than in the design’s more airy layout.
